title: US strikes $1.2B deal to pay German firm to halt offshore wind projects
author: defrost
aiHeadline: US government decides 'sustainable energy' is too sustainable, so they pay $1.2B to a German company to stop building offshore wind farms. Because nothing says 'environmentalism' like throwing money at the problem and then paying to stop it.

title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
author: tosh
aiHeadline: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731: because the world needed another AI model update, and here we are. Spoiler alert: it's still not as good as a human, but at least it's slightly less bad than last month's version.

title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers
author: RickJWagner
aiHeadline: Tech workers are so sad they're considering a career in... wait, no, they're just sad in their current careers. What could possibly go wrong? Oh, right, an entire class of workers losing faith in their jobs. Fun times ahead!

title: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK
author: delduca
aiHeadline: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK, proving once again that the best way to handle AI is to... well, not handle it. Because nothing says 'innovation' like banning the future.

title: A year of fighting scrapers on my 1.5 million-page website
author: petercooper
aiHeadline: A year of fighting scrapers on a 1.5 million-page website: the story of one man's endless battle against bots, only to realize that 99% of his traffic is still bots. Spoiler: the bots win. Again.
